observations: Manual sewing machine mounted on a wooden table with a metal treadle stand.
The brand 'TWO LION' is cast into the metal leg of the stand in photo 0.
The machine head is black with gold decorative decals and a lion logo visible in photo 1.
A drive belt is connected between the handwheel and the treadle wheel in photo 0.
The wooden tabletop shows significant surface scratches and wear in photo 1.
The machine appears to have a needle installed.

claims.evidence: Requires a video of the machine stitching to verify mechanical timing and smooth operation.

risks.risk: Internal gears may be worn, timed incorrectly, or seized from lack of oil.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine stitching through two layers of denim or similar fabric.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring a professional service and timing adjustment

risks.risk: The bobbin case or shuttle hook may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the bobbin area with the slide plate moved aside.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing essential internal parts

risks.risk: The treadle mechanism may be stiff or the bearings worn out.
risks.proof: Video showing the treadle wheel spinning freely and quietly.

proof_requests: Video of the machine being treadled and successfully sewing a line of stitches.
Close-up photo of the bobbin area with the metal slide plate open.
Photo of the underside of the machine head to check for rust on the drive shafts.
response.reason: The item is a standard Two Lion manual sewing machine. While the 'working' claim is unverified, the item is complete enough to be priced at a base value for a used manual machine requiring service.
